title: Drunk Man Attempts A Disastrous Move During Arrest
description:
On March 21st, 2024, Officers in Florida responded to a 911 call reporting an aggressive male demanding entry into a bar which had denied him so. The officers reached the scene and observed the male standing outside the bar with his pants down and masturbating towards the entrance. A CCTV camera near the area captured another angle of the tackle. The male was a low ranked navy official who was visiting Naval Air Station in Florida as part of a group that was training there. Soon, the sergeant arrived to get informed on the officer involved incident. The male made his body go limp and was resisting against the officer’s efforts to seat him properly. While the uncontrollable sobbing was neither helping him nor the officers. The male was identified as a 28-year-old US Navy Diver, Trey. He was charged with indecent exposure of sexual organs, battery on a law enforcement officer, and resisting arrest. The male may be facing a court-martial with the military, in addition to the charges that have already been brought against him in Florida.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
